name: claude-sessions-bridge
description: Lets the local Claude session manager focus or close a specific VS Code terminal tab by its shell process id.

claudeSessionsBridge.portSpan.description: 从上面那个端口起, 最多往后试几个 —— 每个 VS Code 窗口占一个。
